description: This file defines the Java class `Audience` which represents the 'aud' claim in a JWT token, providing methods for parsing from JSON, retrieving principles, and equality checks.

classes.name: Audience
classes.description: A class representing the 'aud' (audience) claim in a JWT, with methods to construct, retrieve principles, and compare instances.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an Audience object from a JSON value containing the 'aud' claim, handling both array and string formats.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Produces an Audience instance with no principles.

methods.name: getSinglePrinciple
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the single principle if only one exists, otherwise an empty Optional.

methods.name: getPrinciples
methods.description: Returns the list of principles contained in the Audience instance.
